html:
SMTO-SKL-0036 — Your Google account needs to be reconnected for Drive

GUID: ae101efa-3fa7-57e6-8989-b20bfbaa23d6
Slug: google-drive-reauthorization-required
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: google-drive

What happened

  • Google no longer accepts SMTO's permission to use this account, for example after a password change, removed access, or a disconnect. SMTO stopped before using your Drive.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Ask SMTO to reconnect your Google account for Google Drive, and approve the request. Google has withdrawn the old permission, so SMTO needs a fresh one from you.
  2. Open the Google sign-in link and sign in with the same Google account as before, then allow the access shown. Using a different account would point SMTO at different files instead of fixing this connection.
  3. If Google shows a security alert, or your organization restricts outside apps, ask your Google administrator to allow SMTO's access. Some workplaces block app access, and Google keeps refusing until that is allowed.

What success looks like

  • Your Drive request completes, and asking SMTO for the connection status shows the account as connected.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't paste your Google password or sign-in codes into the conversation.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Google Drive rejected the account's credentials (HTTP 401 after one token refresh) or the stored google_account authorization_state is not "available".

What this means

  • Drive receives HTTP 401 or the account authorization_state is not available. This diagnostic performs no provider access. The exact failing stage and retained receipt determine whether a request was sent; account, file or event identity must not be substituted during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • Drive receives HTTP 401 or the account authorization_state is not available.

How to diagnose it

  • Inspect the saved state and provider rejection before starting consent.

How to fix it

  • DriveService.execute raises reauthorization_required when authorization_state != "available"; DriveClient.request raises it when Google returns 401 again after a forced refresh. Reconnect the same google_account key (google_drive.connect or auth.google_connect) with the explicitly required Drive features, using the same Google identity.
  • Reconnect the same Google account with the explicitly requested features.

Retry and execution caution

  • Reconnect the same Google account with the explicitly requested features.

How to verify the fix

  • The same intended account is reconnected with explicit required features.

What not to do

  • Do not expose credentials, content or resumable URLs.
  • Do not blindly repeat uncertain writes.

Technical notes

  • This diagnostic performs no provider access. The exact failing stage and retained receipt determine whether a request was sent; account, file or event identity must not be substituted during recovery.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
